Caregiver Monitoring: Develop mechanisms to track caregiver attendance, activity, and response to alerts. System Reliability: Demonstrate how the system handles connectivity interruptions, delayed data transmission, or temporary service failures. Contextual Intelligence: C

The leaderboard updates as results come in. Simple Timing Rule: The rupee, gold, crude oil and the bond yield are measured at 3:30 PM IST and compared with 3:30 PM IST on the previous trading day. Foreign investor flows are settled on NSE's provisional figure for that day, published in the evening. If you vote before 1:00 PM IST, your prediction is for that day. If you vote after 1:00 PM IST, your prediction moves to the next trading day. In short: Before 1:00 PM = today's prediction. After 1:00 PM = next trading day's prediction. Challenge Set: The same 5 macro indicators will remain fixed throughout the challenge week: USD/INR: Will the rupee be weaker or stronger against the US dollar? additions.title: Xplore & Nova Exilaro Article Writing Competition ? Xavier School of Management (XLRI), Delhi
additions.description: Overview When the Algorithm Makes the Call: Who Owns the Decision? In a world where algorithms increasingly influence business decisions, from hiring and pricing to lending and supply chain management, an important question emerges: When an algorithm makes the call, who takes responsibility for the outcome? NovaExilaro and Xplore, XLRI, invite students across India to participate in an individual article writing competition exploring the intersection of technology, management, leadership, and accountability.
